title: Multi-model routing: canary playbook and metric gating for staged A/B rollout
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: validate multi-model routing policy that routes low-latency traffic to quantized model variants while preserving quality and cost targets. Hypothesis: for targeted conversational workloads, routing 30% of traffic to q4_0 variants will reduce per-token cost by ~10% without increasing user-visible latency or degrading quality beyond 1.5% absolute on our automated eval score. Scope: hosted API + dedicated routing layer; exclude private on-prem for initial rollout. This ticket captures the experiment playbook, gating thresholds, telemetry, rollout ramps, rollback criteria, and stakeholder signoffs required to move from canary to full rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Automated eval score delta <= 1.5% absolute compared to baseline over the evaluation window
P95 latency increase <= 50ms at canary traffic levels (measured at token-level for standard persona prompts)
Error rate (5xx + model failures) <= 0.1% during canary and ramp windows
Per-request cost delta <= +12% at worst-case (should typically be cost decrease of ~10%)
Statistical significance: A/B must reach p<0.05 for quality metric or show no material difference after 95% power target with N>=20k generation requests
Monitoring dashboards live and alerting configured for all gating metrics
Runbook and rollback playbook documented and tested in a dry-run
PM + Eng + SRE signoff recorded in ticket comments
